messages:
micah: Heads up — started seeing 95/99p latency spikes on paged-attn workloads when KV page-ins happen. Repro on flashv2 local rig. Trace attached.

tara: Can you paste the p95/p99 numbers and baseline (no-paging) for the same sequence lengths?

micah: Quick paste from the smoke run (mixed seqs 64/256/1024):
```
config: kv_page_size=32KB, pager_threshold=0.6, batch_timeout_ms=3
no_paging (baseline): p50=8ms, p95=28ms, p99=62ms
with_paging (current): p50=12ms, p95=45ms, p99=210ms
observed: spikes correlate with page-in events and block-table hits on cold slots
```

raj: Looks like page-in IO adds ~40–150ms tail depending on NVMe concurrency. Have you tried a soft prefetch on the block-table hotset? Prototype idea: when a hot slot is touched, asynchronously prime the next K pages for that slab.

micah: I haven't tried prefetch. I did run with different pager_thresholds and higher concurrency; latency still tailed. Command I used for profiling:
```
./rdk bench paged-attn --model flashv2 --seqs 64,256,1024 --concurrency 32 --profile flame --out flame.svg
perf record -e cycles:u -g -- ./rdk bench ...
```

kim: Two thoughts: (1) Prefetch could help but increases resident KV size — we need eviction adaptivity. (2) Batching can amortize page-ins: coalesce tokens that would touch the same KV pages into the same kernel invocation. For small seqs, bumping batch_timeout to 6ms gave good amortization in past tests.

raj: Soft prefetch sketch:
```
on_slot_hit(slot_id):
  if is_hot(slot_id):
    for i in range(1, K+1):
      async_prefetch(slot_id + i)
```
Heuristic: K = min(4, contiguous_run_estimate). Prefetch backoff if eviction pressure > threshold.

micah: Kicking off A/B with soft_prefetch=2 and batch_timeout_ms=6 now. Early quick run: p99 dropped from ~210ms -> ~115ms; p95 near unchanged. Will run a full 30-minute trace.

perf-bot: benchmark run complete — run id: bench-279123-01, config: soft_prefetch=2, batch_timeout_ms=6, kv_page_size=32KB. results: p50=9ms, p95=33ms, p99=118ms. Artifacts: s3://bench/279123/bench-279123-01/{flame.svg,profiles/}

tara: This looks promising. Can we gate soft_prefetch behind a runtime flag and surface a metric for prefetch_hit_ratio? Dedicated customers might want to opt-in.

kim: Also adjust eviction: prefetch increases residency for hot neighborhoods. Suggest: adaptive LRU window or a "prefetch_budget" per arena to cap extra pages. Add a spill hint for long-lived KV entries so compaction avoids thrashing.

micah: Filed RFC: 2791234567-soft-prefetch-rfc (will attach the benchmark artifacts and telemetry dashboard mock). Next steps I see: (1) run a 10k-request sample load test with production-like seq distribution, (2) add prefetch toggle + metric, (3) add CI perf guard against tail regressions. @raj can you prototype compaction tweak?

raj: On it. I'll push a small branch with compact-on-prefetch and a microbenchmark by EOD. Also adding a prefetched_pages counter to telemetry.

micah: Thanks. Tagging the thread for oncall if anything regresses: @eng-oncall. Will update when the 10k run completes.
